ideas.idea: Add robots.txt groups for other training crawlers (CCBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended) to complete the block
ideas.why: The config says trainingCrawlers: block but robots.txt names only GPTBot and ClaudeBot, so this extends the stated policy rather than reversing it.

ideas.idea: Reconsider /account being both Disallowed in robots.txt and noindex, since crawlers can't see the noindex
ideas.why: The point is technically accurate, but /account is a deliberate private page and the report itself says the current setup is fine.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD and an address to the visit page
ideas.why: Having no JSON-LD is not a required fix, and the report offers it with a hedge ('might help'), so it is weak structured-data advice.

ideas.idea: Add real directions or an address to the visit page, since the description promises directions
ideas.why: The visit page's description says 'Opening times and directions' but the body has only opening hours, so text and metadata disagree.

ideas.idea: Give each variety its own page
ideas.why: The varieties page claims over forty varieties but names only two, so separate pages would give each variety content that can be found and quoted.
This is accurate because the sitemap has no lastmod, but it is standard advice for any sitemap and has little effect.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph/social tags to pages
ideas.why: It is accurate because no OG tags exist, but it applies to almost any site and mainly affects share previews.
